ems-80821.t: Buses replace trains between Gosford, Hornsby and Epping
ems-80821.x:
Monday 9 and Wednesday 11 November

• Nightly from 8.50pm to 1.30am , buses replace trains between Gosford, Hornsby and Epping. You may need to change buses at Hornsby to continue your journey.

• Trains run to a changed timetable between Newcastle Interchange and Gosford.

• T1 North Shore Line trains run between Hornsby and the City, T9 Northern Line trains run between Epping and the City.

• Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts .

Bus routes
1CN Gosford, express to Berowra, Hornsby and return
2CN Woy Woy, all stations to Point Clare, express to Berowra, all stations to Hornsby and return
4CN Gosford, all stations to Woy Woy and return
50CN Hawkesbury River, Cowan, Berowra and return
8T9 Hornsby, express to Epping and return
82T9 Hornsby, all stations to Epping and return

Monday 9 November

• From 8am to 1pm , buses replace trains between Newcastle Interchange and Telarah or Muswellbrook.

• The 08:29 Newcastle Interchange to Dungog will not run. Catch the 08:48 Newcastle Interchange to Telarah train and change at Maitland for a bus towards Dungog.

• Buses also replace the 10:02 Dungog to Newcastle Interchange service.

• Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts .
